content: This layer encodes all news on a given day and outputs a set news embeddings $\lbrace S^{1}_t, \cdots , S^{l_n}_t \rbrace $ . Each encoded sentence has dimension $d_S$ , which is a hyperparameter of our model. This layer constitutes a key component of our neural architectures and, as such, we evaluate our models considering sentence encoders trained end-to-end, using the BiLSTM attention (subsec:bilstminneratt) and BiLSTM max-pooling (subsec:bilstmmaxpool) architectures, and also transferred from the RCV1 and SNLI as fixed features.
